mapper.sql: id, drama_id, episode_number, title, duration_seconds, bunny_video_id, subtitle_url, width, height, size_bytes, mime, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.drama_id, e.episode_number, e.title, e.duration_seconds, e.bunny_video_id, e.subtitle_url, e.width, e.height, e.size_bytes, e.mime, e.status, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM episodes e JOIN dramas d ON d.id = e.drama_id WHERE e.id = #{episodeId} AND d.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM episodes WHERE drama_id = #{dramaId}
SELECT MAX(episode_number) FROM episodes WHERE drama_id = #{dramaId}
mapper.update: UPDATE episodes SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE episodes SET bunny_video_id = #{bunnyVideoId}, mime = #{mime}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, duration_seconds = #{durationSeconds}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE episodes SET size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
